implementation_identity: official tabpfn package (PyPI 9.2.0) running the pinned V3 regressor checkpoint locally; package version is not the model generation
paper_reference: Prior Labs. TabPFN 3: Machine Learning with Zero Hyperparameter Tuning. arXiv:2605.13986, 2026
lineage_reference_not_this_checkpoint: Hollmann et al. Accurate predictions on small data with a tabular foundation model. Nature 645:453-458, 2025. doi:10.1038/s41586-024-08328-6 (TabPFN v2; ancestry only)

weights.sha256: see weights/weight_identities.json in the run worktree (recorded at download, 2026-10-23)
weights.license: tabpfn-3-license-v1.0 (research and internal evaluation; no commercial use)
weights.download: public huggingface.co snapshot; the package's own interactive license downloader is bypassed by passing the local file path; no token stored or logged

dependency_versions.note: full freeze in requirements.lock.txt; torch cu126 required by host driver 560.35.05

input_mapping: all seven public blocks in INPUT_KEYS order flattened by the shared flatten_inputs to 1465 columns; identical to tree baselines; no feature added or dropped
task_decomposition: 24 independent in-context regression tasks, one per horizon h=1..24, each fitted on the same 1465-column inputs with the h-step raw RRP label

context_policy.context_source: train split only (61273 rows per region), full set, no subsampling
context_policy.label_use: in-context support examples (label context fit); weights never updated; NOT 'no contact with task labels'
context_policy.test_labels: never visible to the adapter; scorer-only

target_space: regressors fitted on raw RRP (train standardized labels inverted once via frozen train mean/std); predictions are raw RRP with no further inverse transform

output_quantiles.point_for_scoring: rearranged q50 by the shared scorer; native mean exists but is not used

randomness.across_seeds: genuinely different ensemble draws of the same frozen checkpoint (max abs diff > 0 verified)

internal_transforms: none beyond the library's own internal preprocessing/standardization; no PCA, no feature selection, no external head
differences_from_paper: no hyperparameter search (paper contribution is hyperparameter-free use); paper regression benchmarks are standard tabular datasets, not probabilistic electricity price forecasting; we do not claim reproduction of paper benchmark scores; multi-fidelity ensembling left at library defaults (n_estimators='auto')
